node.title: How do I Loop over multiple arrays simultaneously ?
node.author: Fox
node.doctext:
Taken from [http://rosettacode.org/wiki/Loop_over_multiple_arrays_simultaneously|RosettaCode]...

How do I loop over multiple arrays and print the ith element of each?

For example, looping over the arrays (a,b,c), (A,B,C) and (1,2,3) to produce the output: aA1 bB2 cC3

Originally posted as a Categorized Question.
